name: Josh Qixuan Sun
description: Josh Qixuan Sun is a Ph.D. candidate in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Waterloo, researching explanation and interpretation of VLAs, robotics and robot learning, and reinforcement and preference learning.

news.text: Our paper LandMarkVLN was accepted to WACV 2027.
Received the STAR Award (formerly the Faculty of Engineering Award).
Our paper on preference-based antibody expression ranking was accepted to ICML 2026.
Received the University of Waterloo’s Graduate Student Research Dissemination Award (GSRDA).
Passed my Ph.D. comprehensive proposal examination and advanced to Ph.D. candidacy.
Our RA-L paper VIL will be presented at IROS 2026.
Our paper VIL was accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L).
